findings.explanation: implementation and detailedImplementation say the 80% alert must be sustained, but the SPL fires on any single sample above 80%, and also when branch_status equals alarm, which the description and dataSources do not mention.

findings.suggested_fix: List branch_status and its allowed values, and name the real SNMP collector and vendor MIB. Verify the Splunkbase ID.
